ACC_source_selection.A0_APP_memory_earliest: cycle c+4 for the same producer
ACC_source_selection.A0_forward_earliest: cycle c+3 for a producer REC issued at c
ACC_source_selection.A0_functional_timing: stored APP and forward-slot APP are both available during A0 cycle c; A0 performs forward QC permutation and registers the permuted result for A1 at c+1
ACC_source_selection.fallback_on_tag_mismatch: fatal error; do not silently fall back to APP memory
ACC_source_selection.selector_rule: aux=0 selects stored APP; aux=1..8 selects forward slot aux-1

REC_pipeline.R0: cycle c; reconstruct newC2V from newly closed compressed state
REC_pipeline.R1: cycle c+1; consume q slot data and compute APP=q+newC2V in check domain
REC_pipeline.R2: cycle c+2; inverse QC permutation and canonical APP production

cycle_convention.D_stage_visibility: A D-stage token issued at c is registered and visible at start of c+D.
cycle_convention.cycle_start: Cycle c begins immediately after rising edge c.
cycle_convention.issue: An issue in cycle c presents operands/addresses during c..c+1 and is captured into stage 0 at the next rising edge.

slot_metadata_contract.ACC_check_cycle: A0 of the consuming ACC issue
slot_metadata_contract.ACC_expected_tag: base column resolved from the ACC instruction layer_id/local_edge_id plus the current iteration epoch
slot_metadata_contract.epoch_or_column_mismatch: fatal error; the core stops issuing and partial output is invalid
slot_metadata_contract.implementation_note: metadata may be held in registers and shall not add a cycle
slot_metadata_contract.producer: REC R2 for the lane whose REC aux value names the slot
slot_metadata_contract.producer_tag_write: column_id_tag is the REC lane base column; iteration_epoch is the current decoder iteration epoch
slot_metadata_contract.retirement: valid clears after the encoded consumer cycle has elapsed, or at memory_safe c+4 when no live scheduled consumer remains
slot_metadata_contract.valid_assertion: start of cycle c+3 for REC issue c, atomically with canonical APP vector visibility
